input.question: Which person or organization did William A. Crowley work for?

documents.text: As the sun set over the bustling streets of São Paulo, Professor William A. Crowley made his way through the crowded corridors of the São Paulo State University's library. The scent of freshly brewed coffee wafted from the café on the second floor, enticing him to take a detour. He couldn't resist the temptation, and soon found himself sipping on a strong Brazilian coffee, surrounded by the hum of students typing away on their laptops. William, a renowned expert in Library Science and Information Studies, had been drawn to São Paulo State University's vibrant academic community several years ago. The university's commitment to innovation and accessibility resonated deeply with his own values, and he had quickly become an integral part of the faculty. As he walked back to his office, William nodded greetings to his colleagues, exchanging brief conversations about everything from the latest research in information retrieval to the upcoming Futebol match between Corinthians and Palmeiras. The warm, tropical air seemed to seep into his bones, and he felt grateful for the opportunity to call this vibrant city home. William's office, tucked away in a quiet corner of the library, was a treasure trove of books, papers, and curious trinkets collected during his travels. A faded poster of the New York Public Library, where he had earned his Ph.D., hung proudly on the wall, alongside a vibrant tapestry woven by a local artisan. The shelves groaned under the weight of dog-eared tomes on everything from metadata standards to the history of Brazilian literature. As he settled into his chair, William's gaze fell upon a stack of papers marked "Projeto de Inovação" – the Innovation Project he was leading, aimed at developing cutting-edge digital libraries for underserved communities across Brazil. His mind began to wander, envisioning the impact this project could have on the lives of countless individuals, and the role São Paulo State University was playing in shaping the future of information access.
